title: Unit Schedules Under a Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Master Agreement
content:
# Master Lease Agreement — Unit Schedules Held by a Business

**Clause.** Under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, a business may hold any number of unit schedules under its master lease agreement; the number is limited only by the credit line and the program tier rules. Consumer customers cannot hold fleet units.

## The clause in parts

| Question | Answer under the clause |
|---|---|
| Who may hold fleet unit schedules? | A business, under its master lease agreement. A consumer customer cannot. |
| Is there a fixed maximum number of schedules per customer? | No. There is no per-customer maximum. |
| What limits the number? | Only the credit line and the program tier rules. |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A business holding a hypothetical twelve unit schedules that orders a thirteenth is not stopped by any count of schedules; whether the order may proceed turns only on the credit line and the program tier rules of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease.
- An individual consumer who asks to lease a work van under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease cannot hold a fleet unit, whatever the credit line would allow.
